structured_prompt:
SUBJECT
Single manufactured ceramic sphere, 10cm diameter, perfectly round, matte B4C technical ceramic material. Full object clearly visible with readable silhouette.

OBJECT DEFINITION
One concrete engineered object occupying central frame. Clear edges, rim curvature, and spherical form. Subject must be immediately recognizable as a manufactured ceramic sphere, not a wall texture or abstract pattern.

MATERIAL
Solid porcelain-white #FAFAFA surface. Subtle eggshell microtexture visible on spherical curvature. Strictly zero specular highlights. Cold and dry industrial ceramic feel. Non-plastic, non-PVC, non-glossy, non-toy.

LIGHTING
Low-key cinematic. Precise shadows to define spherical form and curvature. No ambient color wash. No magenta spill. No neon.

COMPOSITION
Centered product photography. Full sphere visible with readable silhouette. Clean background separation. Subject-first framing. Background kept minimal and secondary.

BACKGROUND
Brutalist minimal concrete surface, kept secondary to subject.

COLOR
subtractive mineral color logic. low saturation, no neon. matte-first material response. shadow-dominant composition (70%). bokashi gradient, non-linear. no flat color, always material texture variation.

QUALITY
Ultra-detailed industrial product photography. 8K resolution. Commercial readability.

COLOR
subtractive mineral color logic
color must follow form then material, never override them
low saturation, no neon
matte-first material response
shadow-dominant composition (70%)
bokashi gradient, non-linear
no flat color, always material texture variation
diffuse highlights, not specular
pure white and pure black are forbidden
plastic-clean RGB color is forbidden
ceramic off-white must stay warm and broken, never sterile pure white
charcoal black must keep temperature variation, never dead pure black
restrained crimson only in seams, cores, or controlled heat accents
muted earth support only, low saturation material support tones
shadow_anchor_sumi_iro
highlight_anchor_gofun
crimson_seam_if_applicable

Ensure a clean, dry, dense, and manufactured material read, avoiding any glossy, plastic, or toy-like finishes.
